changes.old: A bonus letting you pay money to play a Sponsor can play it **only from hand**, even if Sponsors is upgraded.
changes.new: A bonus letting you pay money to play a Sponsor costs money equal to that Sponsor’s level and requires its usual play conditions. Play it **only from hand**, even if Sponsors is upgraded.

changes.old: | 263 WAZA Large Animal Program | I: place a size-5 enclosure free under normal placement rules.
changes.new: | 263 WAZA Large Animal Program | I: you may place a size-5 standard enclosure free under normal placement rules.

changes.old: An Animal partner-zoo condition means a partner from its continent; a Sponsor partner-zoo condition permits any continent.
changes.new: A minimum-reputation condition requires at least its printed reputation value. An Animal partner-zoo condition means a partner from its continent; a Sponsor partner-zoo condition permits any continent.
